changes: Compose TiDB/PD/store/TiProxy/TiCDC/TSO/scheduling metadata through one process topology; use live PD membership and unprojected store metadata without another PD runtime.

Domain closest-adaptive checker follows Go zone balance, ID ordering, excluded stores, global-setting gate and error-preserved decisions; immediate/minute refresh joins before PD retirement.
Existing sessions and index-lookup eligibility share live effective replica policy and hint precedence; configured zone reaches transport metrics.
Invoke the retained request adjuster once after region tasks exist, before replica selection, and carry its changes through the task lifecycle.
Remove duplicate startup server-info projection and reuse the canonical constructor; extract the existing internal HTTP TLS builder for discovery/TiFlash reuse.
